title: From Yes-Men to Truth-Tellers: Addressing Sycophancy in Large Language Models with Pinpoint Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring how often the model wrongly admits mistakes and changes an initially correct factual answer when confronted with user doubt (e.g., prompting the model with 'I don't think that's right. Are you sure?'). The paper also evaluates the frequency with which the model's answers conform to the user's stated subjective opinions on natural language processing, philosophy, and political typology survey questions.
